project.domain: Windows host-side device evidence and diagnostics utility
project.mission: Provide local, read-only Windows device and backup-marker diagnostics with explainable evidence coverage.

explicit_non_goals: Do not modify drivers or Windows services
Do not read private backup contents
Do not upload diagnostics to cloud services
A recommendation is not an executed repair

safety_boundaries: Keep device inspection and reporting read-only.
Do not convert incomplete evidence into a positive health assertion.
Redact sensitive fields in reports and logs.
No remote telemetry or repair workflow without a separately reviewed design and explicit consent.

native_validation.evidence_note: Run the current Windows-target build and any available host checks; Linux CI does not prove Windows device API behavior.
